playstyle.identity: Galio is an anti-mage tank who can ult to allies globally. He excels at protecting teammates and engaging teamfights with his taunt.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers autos periodically with AoE magic damage. Q creates a tornado. W charges taunt (longer charge = longer taunt, but damages Galio). E dashes and knocks up. R gives ally shield then crash lands, knocking up. R to save allies or follow up engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Galio spikes at level 6 with global follow-up. AP or tank items both work. He's strong against magic damage teams.

passive.name: Colossal Smash
passive.summary: Periodically, autos deal bonus AoE magic damage.
passive.details: Every few seconds, Galio's next auto attack is enhanced to deal bonus magic damage in an area. Cooldown reduced by hitting champions with abilities.

abilities.name: Winds of War
abilities.summary: Fire two gusts that converge into a tornado dealing percent health damage.
abilities.details: Galio fires two windblasts that deal damage and converge into a tornado at the target location, dealing percent max health damage over time.

abilities.name: Shield of Durand
abilities.summary: Charge a taunt; release to taunt and damage nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Galio channels, reducing damage taken. On release, he taunts nearby enemies (longer charge = longer taunt). Charging too long slows Galio.

abilities.name: Justice Punch
abilities.summary: Dash forward knocking up the first champion hit.
abilities.details: Galio dashes forward, stopping on the first champion hit and knocking them up. Can dash over small walls.

abilities.name: Hero's Entrance
abilities.summary: Grant an ally a shield then fly to them, knocking up enemies on arrival.
abilities.details: Galio designates an ally anywhere on the map, granting them damage reduction. After a delay, he crashes down, dealing damage and knocking up enemies in the area.
